other_conditions: Applicant must be for a greenfield enterprise.
Applicant must not be in default to any bank or financial institution.
For non‑individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
benefits_summary: Provides composite loans of ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore, along with a RuPay debit card and hand‑holding support through SIDBI’s portal.
